messages:
maya: Heads up — Novacorp POC hit repeated 502/503s during an exec demo, they paused. using hosted sandbox, ~18 concurrent streams.
leo: saw the spike on our dashboards. any request ids from the UI?
maya: they reported req_nvc_01 and req_nvc_07. UI says "Service temporarily unavailable (502)".
ash: checking metrics: region-us-east swarm queue_len jumped to 210, gpu_mem 91%, cpu 70%, error_rate ~15% over 6m. no config deploys in last 20m.
ops-bot: autoscaler event at 1791301310: "scale_up initiated: waiting for image pull; idle_gpus=0; fallback routing enabled". 56 requests routed to fallback-small.
leo: fallback-small has lower concurrency and no KV cache. if primary saturated and fallback gets flooded we'll see timeouts.
maya: customer was streaming long transcripts (~11k tokens) with continuous partial responses.
ash: logs for req_nvc_01 -> fallback-node-12 show repeated upstream timeouts: "Upstream call failed: 504" and markers "throttle: fallback_overrun". also saw frequent kv_cache_eviction events on primary.
leo: quick mitigation options: 1) swap tenant to a compact model with shorter context, 2) cap max_tokens to 4096, 3) enable aggressive kv eviction or prefix_cache, 4) carve a short burst reservation for the demo window.
maya: customer needs a fix now — exec call resumes in 20m. can we push a safe config change?
ash: yes. suggested temporary config: model=rwf-compact, max_tokens=4096, stream_chunk_ms=250, prefix_cache=true. will push.
ops-bot: applying config for tenant novacorp-poc: model=rwf-compact, max_tokens=4096 at 1791301368. rollout 100% to sandbox.
maya: they resumed demo, errors dropped but still seeing intermittent 502s on very long transcripts.
leo: fallback queue still at ~48. we should limit fallback queue size to avoid cascading failures — better to return a 429 early than cascade 5xx. opening INF-5005 to track: "fallback hard-limit + per-tenant circuit breaker".
sales-eng: Novacorp asked about short-term dedicated buffer for the demo. pricing: 2x T4-equiv reserved burst (2h) = one-off $140. monthly reserved mini pool ~ $5.9k/mo.
maya: customer also requested SOC2 summary and questions about customer-managed KMS for sensitive transcripts. flagged for security/sales follow-up.
leo: longer-term engineering items: prewarm images for trial accounts to cut autoscale latency (~90s now), smarter KV eviction based on stream length, and per-tenant guardrails to avoid noisy neighbor.
nash: attaching logs to ticket INF-5004 and upload to S3: s3://redwood-logs/poc/novacorp/17913012/. captured req ids: req_nvc_01, req_nvc_07, req_nvc_0b.
maya: Novacorp wants a postmortem and written mitigation before next exec. I'll own customer comms and coordinate with sales-eng and security.
ops-bot: alert cleared at 1791301560: error_rate returned to baseline.
leo: short runbook snippet for POC throttling: 
1) reduce context model or cap max_tokens to 4096
2) enable prefix_cache for repeated instructions
3) carve short burst reservation for demo window (ops)
4) monitor queue_len < 60 and gpu_mem < 85%
5) if fallback queue > 50, reject early and notify sales

maya: thanks team — will update customer and request SOC2 NDA to share compliance docs. :white_check_mark:
